AuthController - Class in edu.secourse.patientportal.controller
Authentication REST Controller for Maclogix Provides endpoints for user authentication: - User registration (create new account) by Administrator - User login (authenticate and get JWT token) Base Path: /maclogixapi/v1/auth All endpoints are PUBLIC (no JWT required) HTTP Response Status Codes: - 200 OK: Login successful - 201 Created: Registration successful - 400 Bad Request: Invalid input (validation error) - 401 Unauthorized: Invalid credentials (login failed) - 409 Conflict: Username or email already exists - 500 Internal Server Error: Server error Security Notes: - Passwords are encrypted using BCrypt (never stored in plain text) - JWT tokens are issued on successful login - JWT tokens expire after 1 hour
